method: Production localhost; no network or CPU throttling. Three sequential fresh contexts per viewport; explicit no-preference motion; deviceScaleFactor=1. Initial measurement after intro disappearance, fonts ready and 1100ms settling. Entire page after visiting all reveal nodes and every image, decoding images, return to top and 1100ms settling. No concurrent test load during measurement.
limitations: Lab observations, not field Core Web Vitals. First visit has a timed intro; LCP may represent the intro and does not measure when the main interface becomes visible. introReleasedAtMs is observed intro DOM removal; interfaceObservedAtMs is an explicit settled observation, not TTI. transferBytes are Chromium Resource Timing transferSize including response headers for a local Vite preview; encoded and decoded response sizes are recorded separately. CLS is the maximum layout-shift session window; cumulativeLayoutShift is the raw sum. Mobile emulation is Chromium, not a physical phone.
screenshotsNote: Baseline capture images are not included here; this file preserves the fresh baseline measurement samples.
